local_attempt.outcome: total failure — no data ever processed, all 3 workflow replan attempts exhausted
local_attempt.note: Never got past dataset loading. Step 1 (load + apply mandatory sample constraint) itself exceeded the 600s sandbox limit on the first workflow attempt; Step 2 (gads_causal_estimate_ate) also timed out. The workflow replanned twice more (MAX_WORKFLOW_ATTEMPTS=3) — attempt 2 succeeded at loading the full 214,144x6 dataframe but never got a causal estimate before running out of replans; attempt 3's remaining steps are marked 'Workflow exhausted max planning attempts; task never ran.' No estimate, no artifacts beyond the loaded dataframe, ran roughly 2 hours 12 minutes end to end (launched ~03:22, resolved ~05:34) with each retry costing ~10-11 minutes because nothing sampled the 214,144-row dataset down before the native ATE call. Root cause: this spec's data (unlike every other spec in the batch) is large enough that an unsampled native call alone approaches the 600s sandbox timeout, so the model never got a fast-enough loop to iterate on the actual estimation logic. This is a resource/budgeting failure, not a reasoning failure — notably, even GADS's own CLOUD reference run for this same spec hit one timeout on the identical 214,144-row dataset during a robustness step (see notes.md), suggesting the row count itself is a systemic risk for this spec regardless of which model runs it, just one cloud recovered from with tokens/tries to spare and local did not. See notes.md.

estimate.note: GADS canonical from cloud reference run (drafted lane, Fuzzy RDD / 2SLS using GI-bill eligibility as an instrument for actual veteran status `vet_wwko` on the `qob_minus_kw` cutoff): baseline LATE = 0.2846 (p<0.0001; first-stage -0.1923, t=-43.91; reduced-form -0.0547, t=-13.02), refined to 0.3938 (SE=0.0126) after adding race and state-of-birth fixed effects. Both positive and large — matches the published direction (Fetter 2013: subsidy eligibility raised home ownership). Range recorded via tol=0.11 to span both specifications rather than picking one arbitrarily; not an external scalar match since none exists.
